limitations: Source is the DigiKey mirror of the Hirose DM3 Series MicroSD 2010.6 reference catalog, not the latest engineering drawing; the official Hirose site returned HTTP 403 (retained failed acquisitions).
PDF page 3 names DM3AT-SF-PEJM5 with code 609-0031-0.

The card detection switches A/B are normally open and close on card insertion; the JLCPCB attribute "Additional Card Detection Pins: No" is contradicted by this manufacturer evidence and does not override it.
Detect mapping verified by agent-509's delegated reviewer for these sources: manufacturer B is pad 9 (DET_B, SD_CD), manufacturer A is pad 10 (DET_A, GND).
PDF page 2 operating temperature -25 to +85 C includes current-induced temperature rise. This shows the source exists; it does not qualify the actual board thermal or DFM.
annotations.statement: The historical statement above is retained verbatim. Since it was written, the J3 datasheet has been captured: the DigiKey mirror of the Hirose DM3 Series MicroSD 2010.6 reference catalog (sha256 ab978e9d023b8b2d3a5acfe31ead6e9bf1d63b439d21f7f4db662a1e4e3b56af), canonical record telemetry-pod/expansion/production-capture/sources/j3-datasheet/C114218.part-record.json. It is not the latest engineering drawing. Assembly and operating qualification remain pending.
